decode.title: Decode benchmark
decode.modelHint: Select which model the benchmark targets.
decode.modelSwitched: Selected model is no longer served. Switched to {{model}}.
decode.noModels: No models are currently served by this target.
decode.thinkingHint: On by default. Reasoning tokens count toward decode tok/s.
decode.temperatureHint: Default 0.7 · 0 is greedy · 0 to 2. Before v2.70 the bench always ran at temp 0 with thinking off: set 0 to compare with those runs. Temp above 0 can be much slower on servers that use speculative decoding.
decode.concurrencyHint: Levels run sequentially; each opens that many parallel streams.
decode.contextHint: Each stream is prefilled to this many tokens first, then decodes from there. Needs prefix caching and KV room for concurrency × context.
decode.legendAggregate: — total decode tok/s across all concurrent streams.
decode.empty: Pick a prompt type and concurrency levels, then run. Each level opens that many parallel streams and reports aggregate and per-stream decode tok/s.
decode.mixedSettings: These runs use different temperature or thinking settings. Compare tok/s only between runs with the same settings; temp above 0 can be several times slower.

errors.selectModel: Select a currently served model before running the benchmark
errors.selectConcurrency: Select at least one concurrency level
errors.maxTokens: Max tokens must be an integer between 64 and 2048
errors.temperature: Temperature must be a number between 0 and 2
errors.startContext: Start context must be {{min}} to {{max}} tokens (e.g. 131072 or 128k), or empty

prefill.title: Prefill benchmark
prefill.sizeHintModel: Model context {{size}} — larger sizes are disabled. Type a custom token count (e.g. 200k) to add it.
prefill.sizeHintDefault: Unique-prefix prompts; TTFT is time to first token. 128k–300k can take tens of minutes. Type a custom token count (e.g. 200k) to add it.
prefill.sizeTooBig: Does not fit the model context ({{context}} tokens) once the template and reply are added
prefill.legendPrefill: — the server's own prompt-processing timing when it reports one, otherwise tokens computed ÷ (TTFT − calibrated request overhead), with prefix-cache hits excluded and the correction capped at half the TTFT.
prefill.legendTtft: — request start to first streamed token. Tokens, TTFT and tok/s are from the median-rate sample of each size. Each size uses a unique prefix so prefix-cache does not inflate later sizes.
prefill.legendLow: — the overhead was over 30% of the TTFT, so the rate leans on the calibration;
prefill.empty: Choose the context sizes to test, then run. Each size sends a unique prompt and reports prefill tok/s and time to first token.
prefill.lowConfidence: Low confidence: request overhead was over 30% of the TTFT

method.label: Prefill: {{how}}
method.computed: tokens ÷ (TTFT − {{overhead}} ms overhead, capped at half the TTFT)
method.lowConfidence: overhead was over 30% of the TTFT

errors.selectSize: Select at least one context size that fits this model
errors.customRange: Custom size must be an integer between {{min}} and {{max}} tokens (e.g. 131072 or 128k)
errors.customTooBig: Custom size plus template and reply does not fit the model context ({{context}} tokens)
